Use case: precise identity-preserving style-transfer edit for one frame of an existing eight-frame walking animation, NOT a new character drawing.
Input roles: Image 1 is the ONLY edit target and authoritative geometry/pose/framing reference. Images 2, 3, 4 are existing oneBeat cast STYLE references ONLY. Do not transplant any reference character anatomy, clothing, facial features, poses or colors.
Primary request: Retouch ONLY the linework of the lamp character in Image 1 to match the existing cast's hand-inked comic animation style, and add a subtle ground contact shadow. Preserve the original color palette and all character shapes/placements.
Linework: replace the faint gray/speckled double-edge cutout contours with confident clean nearly-black ink contours, organic tapered strokes with selective thicker silhouette/occlusion lines and thinner inner details. Match the line-weight-to-character-size ratio of the teapot/mismatch/cloud reference characters. Fine directional hatch strokes on the shaded side of the lamp shade, cloth folds, sleeve undersides and slippers; controlled small cel-shaded accents, not many new details. Do NOT create an excessively thick vector sticker stroke or white outline. Do not make painterly, watercolor, soft 3D, glossy plastic or generic mascot art.
Absolute invariants: exactly the same sleepy ivory lamp/bulb face and eye placement, same amber/orange lampshade shape and angle, threaded brown neck, raised hand pinching the right lampshade rim, same opposite swinging arm, blue ivory-piped pajamas with two lilac buttons and pocket, ivory-striped cuffed trousers, lilac pompom slippers, and brown cord tail with same plug shape and trajectory as Image 1. Preserve every joint/limb angle, silhouette, foot orientation, stance and overlap of THIS frame; preserve the exact canvas-relative head, hand, hip and foot positions, character scale and margins. This is a traced retouch, not a pose reinterpretation. Eye-level camera, no perspective change.
Ground shadow: add a small dark charcoal/black semitransparent contact shadow drawn as a very low, flattened tapered ink ellipse right under the touching slipper sole, with a denser narrow center at contact and feathered low-opacity edges. A lifted slipper gets only a lighter, softer projected ground shadow, not a dark shadow floating against the lifted sole. No ground strip, floor, ground line or scenery. Preserve the animation's original implied ground baseline.
Cleanup: remove isolated white cutout debris outside the character, especially near the feet/lower-right. Preserve ALL legitimate character details.
Output: exactly ONE full-body edited lamp animation frame, square 960x960 PNG with genuine transparent alpha background, same coordinate system as Image 1. Only character plus contact shadows; no solid black or white background, no checkerboard baked into pixels, no extra characters/props, no text, labels, watermark, frame border, collage or sprite sheet.
Frame 01: preserve the wide stride. Screen-left slipper lies close to the ground with a strong small contact shadow. Screen-right slipper points toe-up and is lifted: a softer lighter shadow must be on the ground below it, not immediately attached to its airborne sole.
